title: ESL_MPRA_2025: analysis and modeling code for COMPASS, a massively parallel assay of human splice variants
description: Analysis and modeling code for COMPASS, a massively parallel reporter assay of 89,000 human splice variant sequences across five human cell lines. Includes the DNA-seq barcode mapping and RNA-seq PSI quantification pipeline, logit and delta-logit transformations, splicing model predictions and retraining (SpliceAI, Pangolin, AlphaGenome, MMSplice, TSplice, MTSplice, HAL), RNA-binding protein motif effect size analysis, cell type specificity analysis, and the code that generates the manuscript figures.
